_meta.note: Static model catalogs extracted from the plugin modules by scripts/generate_model_seed.py. Loaded by agentkthx.model_cache.load_seed_catalog() and used as the initial defaults of the persistent model-catalog cache (and the offline fallback lists). Backend keys must not start with '_' — that prefix is reserved for metadata.
